positions.title: Frontend Engineering Lead
positions.description:
- Owned frontend architecture and technical standards across the product, establishing structure, conventions, error handling, and documentation to improve maintainability and consistency at scale
- Set and drive quarterly frontend technical strategy and priorities, influencing roadmap tradeoffs in partnership with leadership
- Mentored and influenced frontend engineers across the org, reinforcing architectural principles, quality bars, and decision-making frameworks to raise consistency and technical judgment
- Improved frontend reliability, quality, and operational stability by aligning architecture, testing strategy, and CI practices; leading a test overhaul that reduced flaky tests and improved CI runtime, restoring confidence in release pipelines and developer velocity
- Architected and launched a Chrome Extension as a new product surface, owning end-to-end technical design, implementation, and automated release infrastructure, expanding investigative workflows beyond the core platform
- Delivered a customer-facing AI summary feature highlighting malicious prospect objects to drive inbound sales engagement, pairing SEO enhancements with Google Analytics and WordPress workflow integration to improve discoverability and track conversion, adoption, and funnel performance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as tech lead, owning execution from planning through delivery while partnering closely with product and stakeholders to align technical solutions with business goals
- Drove frontend technical strategy during projects and high-level architecture across multiple customer-facing products, setting direction for scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability
- Delivered measurable platform improvements, including reducing data load times through refactoring and caching, and building a multi-tier permissions and authorization system that enabled fine-grained access control while improving security and user experience for newly launched features
- Raised engineering quality and maintainability by optimizing build pipelines, expanding automated testing, enforcing code review standards, modernizing legacy systems, and improving WCAG accessibility compliance

projects.title: Developing tower defense game - Wrong Candy Shop
projects.description:
You walked into wrong candy shop, and you were suddenly trapped by evil candies. Now, you should defend your mouth against those evil candies overloads. Don't worry, fruits and tooth brushes/pastes will help you.
We developed tower defense game at EA Hackathon 2014, called as 'Wrong Candy Shop'. We worked on prototyping with paper and scratch and built up on Unity.

projects.title: Monitube - parental control on TV
projects.description: Monitube is a project participated and awarded in TV and App Hackfest at Appsworld, San Francisco. Monitube allows parents to protect their children from violent and sexual exposure on TV series or movies. Parents can set allowed programs for kids to watch depending on MPAA or TV parental guidelines. When their children are watching any programs not allowed, parents will get the text message. We have used APIs from zeebox, nexmo, alphonso, LG, smart aliance, and zencoder to complete this projects.
